MANRAL
NEW DELHI. MARCH 12

AS THE government brought
home 549 Indian nationals who
had been deceived with fake job
offers and forced into cyber-
crime activities in Southeast
Asia, a probe has revealed that
65 of them are from Uttar
Pradesh, 61 from Maharashtra,
57 from Gujarat and 48 from
Punjab, Ail of them have been
questioned by multiple agencies,
including the CBL
The Indians were flown
home in two batches — 266 on

Monday and 283 on Tuesday —
in military aircraft. Manyof them
had been trafficked to scam cen-

tres operating in Myanmar,
Thailand, Cambodia, and Laos.
